gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Smartish already sells the one-piece Wallet Slayer Vol. 1 in iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max sizes ($29.99 at smartish.com, holds one to four cards plus cash, not compatible with MagSafe or wireless chargers), or that ESR's Geo Wallet Boost does not fit the iPhone 12 mini or 13 mini but does fit the iPhone 17e.
standout_why: I opened three pages. iphoneipadreview.com (2026-11-01) covers phones from the iPhone XS Max and 11 Pro Max up to the iPhone 16 and 16 Pro. It names the Wallet Slayer for the 15 Pro Max and 16 only. It never mentions the iPhone 18, 18 Pro or Air, and it never mentions a MagSafe exclusion for the 12 mini or 13 mini. Macworld's iPhone 17 cases page (2026-09-10) only says cases for the 17e 'have started to appear'. I found no wallet case in the part of that page I could read, and its iPhone 18 mention is just a navigation link. Our current Dealectric page lists only the iPhone 17 Wallet Slayer. Its ESR row says 'Needs a MagSafe case or ESR ring' but does not say which models are excluded. I could not open Wirecutter (the proxy returned 403) or Good Housekeeping (the fetch was blocked), so I could not check those two cited pages.
decides: It confirms the Wallet Slayer Vol. 1 as the one-piece pick for the newest phones. ChatGPT's follow-up question offers 'iPhone 18 / 18 Pro / Pro Max', and the matching case is in stock at the same $29.99. The ESR exclusion splits the MagSafe-wallet pick by model. Owners of a 12 mini or 13 mini should not buy the ESR Geo Wallet Boost or Geo Wallet Stand, while 17e owners can. The page should therefore give a fit table by iPhone model rather than one generic pick.
